outline:
先修課程：3002011或負責教授同意。特徵值、特徵向量及特徵函數，向量分析、向量微積分、傅立葉級數與邊界值問題、偏微分方程、複變函數。
Eigenvalue and Eigenfunction Problems, Vector Analyses, Calculus of Vectors, Fourier Series, Boundary Value Problems, Partial Differential Equations, Complex Analyses.
schedule:
週次 章節內容
01 Course introduction & Review. Matrices and Vectors.
02 Matrix Multiplication & Linear Systems of Equations.
03 Linear Independence & Solutions of Linear Systems.
04 Determinants (Second-/Third-order; Properties; Cramer’s Rule).
05 Inverse of a Matrix & Gauss–Jordan Elimination. (Quiz)
06 The Matrix Eigenvalue Problem & Applications.
07 Symmetric/Skew-symmetric/Orthogonal Matrices & Eigenbases.
08 Vectors in 2-Space and 3-Space; Inner Product; Vector Product.
09 Mid-term exam
10 Curves; Gradient; Directional Derivative.
11 Divergence; Curl.
12 Line Integrals; Path Independence; Double Integrals; Green’s Theorem.
13 Surfaces for Surface Integrals; Surface Integrals.
14 Fourier Series; Arbitrary Period. (Quiz)
15 Even/Odd Functions; Half-range Expansions; Fourier Integral.
16 Basic Concepts of PDEs; Separation of Variables; Wave Equation Modelling.
17 Solution of PDEs by Fourier Series.
18 Final exam
scorePolicy: 平時45%(內含小考30%，平時出缺席考核與課堂行為觀察15%，點名缺席一次扣1%，最多扣至15%)，期中考25%，期末考30%。
materials:
1. 自編教材
2. Erwin Kreyszig, Advanced Engineering Mathematics, 10th edition
